def quat_slerp(a, b, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
    a = np.asarray(a, np.float64); b = np.asarray(b, np.float64)
    d = float(np.dot(a, b))

        return q / np.linalg.norm(q)

"""Write the exemplar 山 with three continuous calligraphic strokes."""
import os, json, argparse, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
from rcb_brush import Session
OUT=Path('/app/output')
def sample(nodes,step=.3):
    t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(nodes,axis=0),axis=1),.5))]
    ts=np.linspace(0,t[-1],int(np.ceil(t[-1]/step))+1)
    return PchipInterpolator(t,nodes,axis=0)(ts)
def generate(pathfile=OUT/'fit.npz',name='trajectory',score=True):
    data=np.load(pathfile); paths=[data[k] for k in data.files]
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');s.reset();p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    def move(pos,speed=.05,settle=0):
        result=p['move_tip'](pos,speed=speed,settle=settle)
        if result['ik_failures']: print('IK warning',result,flush=True)
    def world(row):
        return np.r_[s.geo.mm_to_world(*row[:2]),.020-row[2]/1000]
    for i,nodes in enumerate(paths):
        print('stroke',i,'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
        cur=s.tip_pose()[0];move([cur[0],cur[1],.055],settle=4)
        move([-.100,.150,.055]);move([-.100,.150,.025],speed=.025,settle=8)
        move([-.100,.150,.055],settle=4)
        first=world(nodes[0]); move([first[0],first[1],.055],settle=4)
        direction=world(nodes[1])-first;direction[2]=0;direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
        approach=first-direction*.003;approach[2]=.022
        move(approach,settle=5);move([first[0],first[1],.021],speed=.01,settle=6)
        for row in sample(nodes):
            q,ok,err=s.ik(world(row))
            if not ok:raise RuntimeError(f'IK failure {err}')
            s.step(q)
        last=world(nodes[-1]);move([last[0],last[1],.035],speed=.01,settle=8)
    p['hold'](20)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/f'{name}.npz')
    cv2.imwrite(str(OUT/f'{name}.png'),s.canvas()[:,:,::-1]);np.save(OUT/f'{name}_ink.npy',s.ink())
    records=s.strokes();np.savez(OUT/f'{name}_samples.npz',**{f'p{i}':r['samples'] for i,r in enumerate(records)})
    print('saved',len(actions),'actions','state',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
    if score:
        result=s.status();print(json.dumps(result,indent=2),flush=True)
        (OUT/f'{name}_metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
    return s,actions
if __name__=='__main__':
    a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('--paths',default=str(OUT/'fit.npz'));a.add_argument('--name',default='trajectory');a.add_argument('--no-score',action='store_true');args=a.parse_args()
    generate(args.paths,args.name,not args.no_score)
